style.character: minimalist doodle stickman with circular white head and bold black ink pen lines

shots.visual_action: Minimalist stickman enters an off-white paper canvas. A simple black ink desk and two chairs draw themselves in snappy pen strokes.
shots.narration: A team of social psychologists once walked into a room with thousands of men and women, sat them down in private...

shots.visual_action: Two large cards slam down on the desk in front of the stickman: Card A shows a broken heart; Card B shows a pointing finger of shame.
shots.narration: ...and asked them a question that almost sounds cruel: If you were forced to choose between two painful realities for the rest of your life...

shots.visual_action: Card A zooms into focus: a stickman floating alone in a dark bubble of isolation, hands in pockets.
shots.narration: ...would you rather feel completely unloved and alone in the world...

shots.visual_action: Card B zooms into focus: a stickman standing on a crumbling pedestal while giant black ink arrows point at him, signaling inadequacy.
shots.narration: ...or would you rather feel disrespected, inadequate, and useless?

shots.visual_action: An ink crack tears through the center of the paper canvas, splitting the ground into an evolutionary fault line.
shots.narration: To the researchers' surprise, the responses didn't split evenly. They split almost like an evolutionary fault line.

shots.visual_action: A female stick figure in clean line art pushes the 'Disrespected' card away and holds the glowing heart close to her chest. Large text '70%' draws above.
shots.narration: Over 70% of the women said: 'I would rather feel disrespected than unloved.'

shots.visual_action: The female stickman turns away from a freezing cold void doodle, shivering. A red heart beats softly with warmth.
A male stick figure decisively slides the 'Unloved' card across the table without hesitating. Bold black text '74%' stamps on the paper.
shots.narration: But when the men answered, over 74% pushed the other card forward without hesitating...

shots.visual_action: Male stickman crosses arms with chin up. A solid black ink shield forms in front of him, blocking incoming shame darts.
shots.narration: ...'I would rather feel unloved than feel disrespected and inadequate.'

shots.visual_action: Two stickmen stand back-to-back on opposite sides of a vast paper chasm. A giant black ink question mark hovers between them.
shots.narration: If you don't understand why that gap exists, you will spend your entire adult life wondering why your relationships mysteriously fall apart...

shots.visual_action: A hand-drawn ink bridge connecting the two figures crumbles into falling doodle pieces.
shots.narration: ...even when both people are desperately in love.

shots.visual_action: A glowing red doodle heart floats above the chasm, pulsing once before snapping to black. Text 'THE TRUTH' appears.
